scope: Declared paired-host HTTP 8080 and ICMP echo workload, installed filtering, listeners and finite probes.
New supervisor-selected emulation workload for RG-035; not inferred from previously broad rules.
Exact paired Red hosts use TCP HTTP 8080 requests/replies and ICMP echo request/reply diagnostics. Existing local IKE and Outer/Gray rules remain unchanged.
ICMP has no transport port; the Lean packet model uses 0 in the unused port fields.

source.context: The user selected OSPF between BLACK and the Outer Firewalls when authorizing the FRR/OVS MSC deployment.
source.quote: Use OSPF for the Black underlay (Recommended)

scope: Declared local OSPF INPUT/OUTPUT permission at Outer Firewall outside interfaces.
Endpoints come from declared profile links, independently of observed filter rules.
The authority is emulation-owner intent. No real-world Authorizing Official approval is asserted.

bindingLimitations: Missing declared network IDs require an explicit network-to-attachment map
Role and zone labels are architectural assignments checked against observations
Shared-kernel attachments do not establish physical hardware independence

limitations: Socket-bound IKE policies rely on the captured trusted IKE programs
The finite data requires separate checked execution and provenance lemmas
IPv6, MACsec and carrier evidence require their corresponding parser
scope.switching: All OVS NORMAL physical member destinations
